title: Grateful Dead Live at Onondaga War Memorial  on 1971-10-27
lineage: Bertha Remaster of the Master Reel/Cassette source
source: SBD > MR > CASS > DAT > DAW(Bertha) > Audio DVD > DVD Audio Extractor v.3.3.2 (audio files extracted prior to burning to DVD disc) > 24/48 wav > downsampled to 44.1 wav with Wave Lab v.5.00a > dithered from 24 to 16 bit depth with Wave Lab UV22 HR Plugin > SBEs fixed with shntool v.2.0.3 (by set) > FLAC encoding with FLAC Frontend v.1.7.1 Etree Edition, FLAC v.1.1.2 (level 8)

ai_review.summary: A high‑energy 1971 show captured on a pristine WAER soundboard remix, featuring scorching rock numbers and a standout "Comes A Time" breather.
ai_review.review: The performance bursts with metallic rock energy—"RR Blues," "Cumberland," "One More Saturday Night" and a fiery "Bertha" are highlighted—while "Comes A Time" offers a perfect melodic respite. The newly remastered WAER soundboard source delivers crystal‑clear instrument separation, putting Jerry, Phil, Bob and Keith front‑and‑center in the mix. Overall the show is praised as a quintessential early‑'70s Dead experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Five reviews (four 5‑star, one neutral) consistently praise both the musical performance and the high‑quality remastered soundboard recording, indicating an exceptional show with excellent audio.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remastered WAER broadcast; crisp, clear mix with prominent guitars, vocals and keyboards; no noted dropouts or major flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A hard‑rock driven first half with heavy riffs, punctuated by the gentle breather of "Comes A Time"; the energy stays high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Prominent in the mix; passionate singing with occasional falsetto on "Comes A Time."
band_member_comments.Phil: Prominent in the mix; contributes strong bass presence.
band_member_comments.Bob: Prominent in the mix; solid rhythm guitar and vocals.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith is right in the pocket and well represented in the mix, surprising for a recent addition.
